result.stdout:
codemetrics <path> [--format human|json] [--json <file>] [--top N]
           [--no-semantic] [--max-degree N] [--no-dedup] [--exclude <glob>]
           [--fail-on <key>=<value>] [--config <file>] [--help] [--version]

  <path>          directory or .cs file to analyze
  --format        human (default) or json to stdout (shared finding schema v1)
  --json <file>   also write full results as json to <file>
  --top N         rows per console table (default 10)
  --no-semantic   skip type/namespace metrics; syntactic only, constant memory,
                  no compilation (for very large repositories)
  --max-degree N  parallelism (default 4, this machine)
  --no-dedup      do not collapse byte-identical files (dedup is on by default)
  --exclude <g>   skip paths matching glob (repeatable; substring if no wildcard)
  --fail-on <k>=<v>  exit 1 if any finding breaches; repeatable. Two forms:
                  severity=<critical|high|moderate|low|info> (any diagnosis at-or-
                  above the level), or <metric>=<number> where metric is
                  cyclomatic|cognitive|nesting|lcom4|coupling (max) or mi (min)
  --config <file> .dependably JSON to read rules/failOn/exclude/exceptions from
                  (.dependably-check is the deprecated alias filename). Discovered
                  from <path> up to the repo root when omitted; CLI
                  --fail-on/--exclude override/extend it.
  --help          print this usage and exit 0
  --version       print the tool version and exit 0
